experiments.scope: The SHIFT39-41 construction (k = 2): one verified 39-step factory pair moved up two steps, organizer seeds, 256 trials. Per trial the program emits the two shifted block-2 messages and the recomputed numeric observations of the schedule identity, the two-step cancellation over 2,000 seed-drawn block-1 chaining values, the free-word set S, and the shared-budget price.
experiments.hypothesis: The schedule identity N_t = W_{t-2} holds (observations.schedule_identity_ok = 1), the two-step cancellation equalises the state after steps 0-1 for every drawn chaining value (observations.cancel_ok = observations.cancel_total), the free word N1 yields observations.S_size = 64 distinct dN0 all equal mod 2^13, and the shared-budget total is observations.total_log2 = 121.504737 against the board R41 bar 123.92331.
